name: com.tencent.android.vivopush.VivoPushMessageReceiver
description: When Vivo Push delivers a message or updates its registration token, this Tencent TPNS receiver forwards the event to TPNS; it can also open links attached to tapped Vivo notifications.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Vivo-channel messages and registration updates and from opening supported notification links.
